name: Kungfu Card
detailed_description:
"Kung Fu Cards" is a brand-new card battler themed around traditional Chinese martial arts, combining rules from poker and mahjong with modern board game design while offering both PvP and PvE gameplay. Choose your martial arts school, master internal techniques and special moves, defeat renowned fighters in thrilling arena matches, and claim your title as the ultimate grandmaster!

🌟FEATURES

Kung Fu Duels, Counters and Breakthroughs

Experience a unique gameplay system that seamlessly merges traditional card games with modern board games. The shared deck of number cards and stance cards tests both your luck and strategy, while your customized internal techniques and special moves can turn the tide of battle.

Modify your hand through internal techniques manipulation, switch between fighting stances for different advantages, and carefully time your counters to unleash devastating special moves—bringing the excitement of fighting games into a strategic card-based format.

Punches and kicks, Establish Your School

Immerse yourself in faithfully recreated traditional Chinese martial arts schools. Each internal technique is based on authentic kung fu principles and training methods, with special moves drawn from historical martial arts documentation.

The game features 5 distinct schools, each with 8 internal techniques and 8 special moves. Rather than simple stat boosts, these abilities center on unique mechanics, allowing you to develop various fighting styles within each school.

Arena Gatherings, School Challenges

Test your skills in the fighting game-inspired Arena mode, where you'll choose a school and master its techniques to challenge various opponents on your way to winning the National Martial Arts Tournament. Or dive into the roguelite Challenge mode, where you'll craft techniques from different schools and use various items to spar with disciples and masters, building your school's reputation across the land.

Online Competition, Ultimate Showdowns

Connect with friends through local host rooms or compete in ranked matches on our servers. Beyond the standard 1v1 duels, enjoy various special modes including blind card matches and 3-4 player free-for-alls, letting you test your skills against friends and masters worldwide.
